notes: Observed depth_m = CGWB convention (m below ground level; larger = deeper).

Simulated gw_level sign convention must be confirmed from Phase 4 environment code. If simulated gw_level also uses depth-below-ground, the two are directly comparable; if it uses 'height above datum', signs will be inverted.
Seasonal cycle alignment uses month recovery from month_sin/month_cos (atan2); binned to integer months for plotting.
